content.comment_body: A public IP address was assigned for remote access to the [product_name] device via the internet. When attempting to connect, the web login page appears immediately. After logging in on the customized web page, it loads but then closes again within a second. This behavior persists across multiple browsers and different internet connections from various client devices. However, connecting over the local network works without issue. Any help would be appreciated. Firmware [version_no].
Can you clarify which web server you are trying to access? Is it the basic server that mirrors the display and keyboard, or the extended server where custom web pages can be created?

The basic web pages function properly on both local and remote connections. The issue occurs with the customized site, which fails to stay open and quickly redirects back to the login page after displaying. The page only shows six standard digital values and uses default components, with no custom HTML. Access to the custom page works perfectly on the local network.

It seems likely that the problem is related to the extended web server, possibly due to increased loading times when accessing it over the internet instead of the local network. I recommend submitting a Support Request.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are encountering a problem where the customized web interface for [product_name] devices closes almost instantly after logging in over a public internet connection, while basic web pages and local network access work as expected. This suggests a stability or performance issue specifically impacting remote access to the extended web server. Multiple browsers and connections have been tested, making client-side concerns less likely.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect the customized web interface for [product_name] devices to operate smoothly and reliably over the internet, similar to its performance on local networks, to facilitate remote monitoring and control.
